_doc: A stand-in art pack for the item icons (tests/unit/test_item_icon_art.gd): the asset_index.json shape with one item that has a rendered icon. The icon is an SVG (text, imported as a texture like the pack's PNGs) whose drawing is small, tall and off-centre, so the test can see the framing. The Sword (1302000) is listed with no icon file, and every other item is absent.
name: MisoStory item icon stand-in
